parameters.content:
## AI Inbox & Invoice Processing Agent (Portfolio Demo)
POST /webhook/inbox-agent  —  body: { from, subject, bodyText, attachmentName, attachmentBase64 }

ONE-PAGE FLOW (matches the brief):
1 Shared inbox (Gmail / IMAP)
2 Read PDF attachments, incl. scanned (OCR)
3 Classify: urgent / request / invoice / routine
4 Extract: sender, PO/invoice no., amount, due date
5 Validation  -> fails -> Needs review (human queue, nothing dropped)
6 Duplicate check -> already seen -> Duplicate (skipped, no second record)
7 Write one row: Google Sheets or Airtable
8 Save attachment: Google Drive, linked to the row
9 Money or outgoing?  -> no -> Recorded only
10 Approval queue (pending a human decision)
11 Human OK -> send / pay

ALERTS & RELIABILITY: Slack alert for urgent items; morning summary once a day; retries before alerting; failure alerts via the Error Trigger workflow.
LOGGING: every step is written to the execution log (n8n execution history + inbox_messages / approval_queue), so someone else can maintain this. Full runbook: the setup guide.

BEFORE RUNNING: set credentials on Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack (x2) and Gmail, and pick folder / spreadsheet / channels / recipient. The webhook stands in for Gmail Trigger / IMAP in production.
